title: Available numbers show which business-address area applies
summary: Available numbers now name the area a local number's business address must be in for its ownership paperwork, when that area is known.
body_markdown:
[Get](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-available-number) and[list available numbers](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/list-available-numbers) can now return` ownership_address_area_name` (for example` Amsterdam` ) for a local number whose` ownership_address_scope` is` number_area` , meaning its ownership paperwork needs a business address inside the number's own area. The field names the area when it is known and is omitted otherwise. The[buying numbers guide](https://bird.com/docs/guides/numbers/buying-numbers) also now states that a number carrying` ownership_address_scope` is removed if its paperwork isn't approved by the registration deadline, with any setup fee credited back but its first recurring charge not refunded.


Also in this release:


- **WhatsApp and Apple Messages for Business conversation labels match in any casing.** Updating a conversation's` labels` , or filtering conversations by` label` , now matches your workspace's labels regardless of case, and responses return the workspace's spelling. Updating with a name your workspace doesn't have creates a new workspace label (up to 100 per workspace), unless it uses a reserved name, which now also includes` archive` ,` blocked` ,` outbox` ,` scheduled` , and` sent` ; labels your workspace already has keep working. Filtering by a name your workspace doesn't have matches nothing. See[update a WhatsApp conversation](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/update-whatsapp-conversation) and[update an Apple Messages for Business conversation](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/update-amb-conversation) .
- **10DLC brand registration now requires your website and sign-in email to share a domain.** Submitting or resubmitting a brand needs a live website whose main domain matches the domain of the email address you sign in with; an address on a subdomain or a free email provider is refused. See[Register a 10DLC brand](https://bird.com/docs/guides/sms/10dlc) .
